name: Roasted Leg of Lamb
ingredients: As needed - Your favourite rub/spices (garlic, salt, pepper, rosemary, thyme, etc.)
instructions: Pat roast dry with paper towels. Rub with oil and season all over with kosher salt and black pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temp for at least 1 hour or up to 2 hours.
Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Set a wire rack inside. Transfer roast to baking sheet, fat side up. Rub with your favourite spices.
Roast until meat registers 100KF, about 1 3⁄4 hours.
Pour 1⁄4 cup of water into the baking sheet. Increase oven temperature to 450KF and roast until lamb registers 125˚F, medium rare, about 20 minutes.
Transfer roast to carving board and let rest for 20 minutes. Slice and serve.

additional_context.tips: Resting: Muscle fibres tighten when meat cooks. The fibres relax as the meat cools resulting in more juice staying in the meat when sliced. Roasting quickly vs a long slow cook: A long slow cook breaks down tough ligaments and collagen in the leg (and shoulder); however, over-cooking dries out meat, requiring moisture to be added during cooking or before serving. Roasting to medium-rare eliminates this problem.
